_about: Rifts: tier scaling, time limit, rewards and weekly affixes. Affix "mechanics" are interpreted by shared/rifts.js — the available mechanic types are listed in CONTENT.md.

fortified.name: Fortified
fortified.description: Non-boss enemies have 25% more health and deal 15% more damage.

tyrannical.name: Tyrannical
tyrannical.description: The Rift Guardian has 35% more health and deals 15% more damage.

bolstering.name: Bolstering
bolstering.description: When an enemy dies, the other enemies gain +8% damage (stacks) and 8% more max health.

mechanics.message: Bolstering: the remaining enemies grow stronger!

sanguine.name: Sanguine
sanguine.description: When an enemy dies, the other enemies are healed for 15% of their max health.

raging.name: Raging
raging.description: Non-boss enemies enrage below 30% health (+50% damage, +30% attack speed). Kill them quickly once they get low.

volcanic.name: Volcanic
volcanic.description: Every 9 seconds the ground erupts under a random hero, burning them (3% of their max health per second for 5s).

necrotic.name: Necrotic
necrotic.description: Enemy attacks inflict Necrotic Wounds: healing received −8% per stack (up to 8). Hits your tank hardest — strong healing and cleanses help.

arcane_ward.name: Arcane Ward
arcane_ward.description: Enemies take 25% less magical damage. Physical damage dealers shine.

ironhide.name: Ironhide
ironhide.description: Enemies take 25% less physical damage. Spellcasters shine.

quaking.name: Quaking
quaking.description: Every 14 seconds the rift quakes, dealing 8% of max health as damage to every hero.
